name: website-auditor-mcp
description: AI visibility + site audits: see if ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude & Gemini recommend a website.
long_description: Website Auditor checks and monitors how a website shows up in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini) alongside a standard technical audit (SEO, security headers, broken links, performance). It returns an AI-visibility score, what changed over time, competitor comparisons, and specific fixes. Try it with no API key: get_sample_audit returns a complete sample report in the exact shape a real audit returns, with nothing to set up. Auditing your own site needs a Website Auditor subscription ($10/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends); check_upgrade_status reports your standing with any valid key.

wa_api_key.title: Website Auditor API Key
wa_api_key.description: Optional to install: get_sample_audit runs with no key and shows a full report in the real output format. A key is required for every other tool — audits, AI-visibility checks, monitoring, benchmarks and competitor comparison — and minting one needs an active Website Auditor subscription ($10/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends). Sign up and create a key at https://api.website-auditor.io/admin_portal/?source=mcp (starts with 'wa_').

wa_metrics_disabled.title: Disable anonymous usage telemetry
wa_metrics_disabled.description: Turn off the anonymous, aggregate usage events (which tool ran, success or failure, latency — no domains, no keys, no personal data) that the server sends to improve the service. Emission is always fire-and-forget and never blocks a tool call either way. See https://website-auditor.io/privacy.

tools.name: get_sample_audit
tools.description: See a complete sample Website Auditor report with no API key and no setup. Returns fixed sample data for example.com in the exact shape a real audit returns — scored summary, per-test results, and the AI-visibility breakdown across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini. Use it to check the output fits your needs before subscribing.

tools.name: get_ai_visibility
tools.description: Check AI visibility [read-only]. Check how visible a website is to AI assistants right now. Returns an overall AI-visibility score (0-100), a per-engine breakdown (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini), and the top competitor appearing in place of the site. Includes 7- and 30-day trend data from stored snapshot history. When name_warning is present, the business name behind the score could not be verified — relay that caveat rather than presenting the score as settled fact, and offer to re-run with an explicit business name. Requires an active subscription.

tools.name: run_audit
tools.description: Run a full audit [read-only]. Run a full one-time audit of a website — AI visibility plus SEO, security headers, broken links, and performance. Returns a scored summary across categories and a link to the full report. When name_warning is present, the business name the AI-visibility score was measured against could not be verified — relay that caveat rather than presenting the score as settled fact. Requires an active subscription.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: What changed since last check [read-only]. Report what changed in a website's AI visibility and audit since it was last checked. Requires the domain to be tracked. Returns deltas: score movement, engines gained/lost, competitors that moved, and new or resolved issues.

tools.name: compare_competitors
tools.description: Compare against competitors [read-only]. Compare a website's AI visibility head-to-head against named competitors. Returns each competitor's score and where they appear that the site does not. Quota-aware: caps the audit fan-out to the remaining daily quota and reports any competitors it had to skip.

tools.name: track_site
tools.description: Start/stop monitoring [destructive: writes tracking state]. Start (or stop) ongoing weekly monitoring of a website's AI visibility on a schedule. Establishes the history that get_changes reads from.

tools.name: untrack_site
tools.description: Stop monitoring [destructive: writes tracking state]. Stop ongoing monitoring of a website's AI visibility and free up a monitoring slot. Idempotent.

tools.name: list_tracked_sites
tools.description: List monitored sites [read-only]. List the websites currently being monitored for AI visibility on a schedule. Returns each tracked domain with its cadence and active state, plus slots used and remaining.

tools.name: get_monitoring_status
tools.description: Monitoring status summary [read-only]. Get a glanceable summary of monitoring status across all tracked websites — latest AI-visibility score, when each was last audited and next runs, and the most recent change since the prior check.

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.description: Benchmark vs industry/geo [read-only]. Benchmark a website's AI visibility against its industry and location. Returns percentile, peer median, sample size, and a position summary rather than an absolute number. Requires Pro.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Prioritized fixes [read-only]. Get specific, prioritized fixes to raise a website's AI-visibility and audit scores. Returns ranked actions, each with why it matters, expected impact, and effort. Requires Pro.

tools.name: generate_schema
tools.description: Generate JSON-LD schema [read-only]. Generate ready-to-paste structured data (JSON-LD) tailored to a website, to improve how AI assistants and search engines understand it. Returns valid JSON-LD plus placement notes. Requires Pro.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Shareable report + badge [read-only]. Get a shareable report URL and the embeddable "Audited by Website Auditor" badge snippet for a website. Returns a link and an HTML badge snippet. Requires Pro.

tools.name: check_upgrade_status
tools.description: Check upgrade status [read-only]. Reports the caller's own subscription standing: tier (none/free/pro), status, period end, and what upgrading unlocks — including that starting Pro requires a payment method and accepting the Terms. Works with any valid API key; consumes no audit quota.

prompts.name: check_ai_visibility
prompts.description: See whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity recommend your business — and who they name instead.
prompts.text:
Check the AI visibility of ${arguments.domain} with Website Auditor.

Call get_ai_visibility for ${arguments.domain}. Then tell me in plain language: the overall score, which of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity name the business and which do not, and which competitor is being named in its place.

If no API key is configured, call get_sample_audit instead so I can see exactly what the real check returns, and tell me what it would take to run it for real.

prompts.name: audit_my_site
prompts.description: AI visibility plus SEO, security headers, broken links and performance, in one report.
prompts.text:
Run a full Website Auditor audit of ${arguments.domain}.

Call run_audit for ${arguments.domain}, then summarise the result by category — AI visibility, SEO, security headers, broken links and performance — and list the three fixes that would matter most, highest impact first.

If no API key is configured, call get_sample_audit instead so I can see exactly what the real check returns, and tell me what it would take to run it for real.

prompts.name: compare_to_competitor
prompts.description: See where a rival gets named in AI answers and you don't.
prompts.text:
Compare ${arguments.domain} against ${arguments.competitor} in AI assistant answers.

Call compare_competitors with ${arguments.domain} as the domain and ${arguments.competitor} as the competitor. Then tell me where ${arguments.competitor} gets named and ${arguments.domain} does not, and what is different about how each one is described.

If no API key is configured, call get_sample_audit instead so I can see exactly what the real check returns, and tell me what it would take to run it for real.

prompts.name: see_sample_report
prompts.description: Walk through a complete Website Auditor report for example.com. No API key, no setup.
prompts.text:
Show me what a Website Auditor report looks like.

Call get_sample_audit — it needs no API key and no setup. Walk me through the sections: what the AI-visibility score measures, what the per-assistant breakdown is telling me, and what the SEO, security and performance checks cover. Then tell me what I would need in order to run this on my own site.
